segmentation_update.kind: Gibbs — exact draw from p(S_n, z_n | x_n, Theta)
segmentation_update.rng: one draw per trace per sweep, taken sequentially from the single chain generator in trace order

table_lifecycle.built: once per segmentation sweep, for every candidate block
table_lifecycle.invalidated: immediately after the FFBS draw, before any parameter moves
table_lifecycle.parameter_phase: evaluates only the selected blocks, through the frozen Stage 6E SkillBlockLikelihood
